title: Medicare Hospice Caps Leave Patients Without Care
summary: Critics say the payment limits to companies penalize patients who are not dying on the government’s timetable.

title: With Measles on the Rise, Some Families Are Forgoing Thanksgiving Travel
summary: With measles cases on the rise, some new parents are choosing not to travel, unwilling to chance airplanes, trains or even drives into areas with high infection rates.
